name: Hanegasaki Miyako
source:
The younger Hanegasaki twin is an introverted and shy girl who can normally be found hiding behind her older sister. Humble and kind, she evokes in others the desire to protect her.
She's still in shock after losing her childhood friend in the car accident that she managed to survive.
She has since confined herself to her room while she recovers from her injuries.

[From [url=https://lilja-natsuka.frontwing.co.jp/en/]Official Website[/url]]
